description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter app called SmartTutor. It sets up routing, theming, navigation, user authentication initialization, and manages the main UI structure including a bottom navigation bar with several screens.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Root widget for the application, configurable with routes and theme.

classes.name: _AppState
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the main navigation, user authentication status, and UI updates.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the App widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initializes the authentication process when dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree representing the app's main UI with navigation and theming.
